title: 2.3.28 Build a Four-Case Switch: Drink Sizes
description: Write a switch with at least four cases and a default that prices a drink by size. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice writing a four-case-plus-default switch, ahead of 2.3.30 A2.3.1 Print Settings Advisor

steps.title: Create a variable to switch on
steps.instructions: Create a variable called size set to one of 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'.

steps.title: Write the switch
steps.instructions: Write a switch on size with a case for each of 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', each printing a price you choose. Add a default that prints a message for a size that doesn't exist. End every case with a break.
